Anthony Davis is available for Washington at Detroit. The 8:00 am MYT games have tipped; Hawks lead the Lakers early. We could not find live scores for Cavs-Hornets or Wizards-Pistons, so those estimates are unchanged. Next news: lineups for Pacers-Mavs (9:00) and Nuggets-Rockets (9:30 MYT) about 30 min before tip.
